title: Hare and the Lion's Well
author: Conte d'Afrique de l'Ouest
desc: Le lion mange un animal chaque jour. Le petit lièvre a une idée pour le tromper.

p: In the savannah, there lived a big, hungry lion. Every day, he killed many animals. The antelopes, the zebras, the buffalos were all afraid.
One day, the animals had a meeting under the big baobab tree.
"We cannot live like this," said the old elephant. "Let's go and talk to the lion."
They went to the lion. "King Lion," they said, "please stop hunting. Every day, we will send you one animal for your dinner. Then you can rest, and we can live in peace."
The lion thought about it. It was a good idea. He did not have to run. "OK," he said. "But if one day nobody comes, I will kill you all."
Every day, one animal went to the lion. Every day, the lion ate.
Then one day, it was Hare's turn. Hare was small, but he was very clever.
He walked very, very slowly. He stopped to eat grass. He stopped to sleep under a tree. When he arrived, the sun was going down.
The lion was furious. "Why are you so late? And why are you so small? You are not even a snack!"

"Oh, King Lion," said Hare, "it is not my fault. There were five of us coming for your dinner. But on the way, another lion stopped us. He ate the four others. He says he is the king of the savannah now, not you."
"Another king?" roared the lion. "Impossible! Show me this lion. I will kill him!"
Hare took him to an old, deep well. "He lives down there," said Hare. "Look."
The lion looked into the well. In the water, he saw a big lion with angry eyes. It was his own reflection, but he did not know it.
The lion roared. The lion in the well roared too.
"How dare you!" shouted the lion. And he jumped into the well to fight the other lion.
Splash! He fell into the deep water, and he never came out.
Hare ran back to the baobab tree. "My friends! No more dinner for the lion! We are free!"
And that day, all the animals of the savannah danced, and the smallest of them all was the hero.
